tour.title: Project Entry Points
tour.description: Start here: the module registry (lib.rs) wires every subsystem via #[path] attributes, Cargo.toml declares all feature flags that gate external dependencies, and README.md frames the value proposition and 60-second install path.

tour.title: Canonical Data Model
tour.description: MemoryRecord is the single unit of storage — it carries a MemoryType discriminant (Temporal/Symbolic/Procedural/Reflexion), a SHA-256 integrity hash, and metadata. The data_model.md spec documents query semantics and storage invariants.

tour.title: Memory Persistence & Security
tour.description: MemoryStore is the persistence facade: it enforces AES-GCM encryption, a write-ahead log for crash recovery, Merkle-chained audit.log, and snapshot rollback. SafetyGuardrail wraps every mutation — no write bypasses check_precondition.

tour.title: Core Memory Subsystems
tour.description: Four specialized subsystems handle storage: TemporalIndexer (segmented ring buffer + Markov ordering), SymbolicStore (petgraph-backed knowledge graph), ProceduralCache (FSM-driven traces), and AureusBridge (reflexion/chain-of-thought hook that optionally calls LLM connectors).

tour.title: Perception, Integration & LLM Connectors
tour.description: PerceptionAdapter normalises multimodal inputs (text, embeddings, agent messages, vision) through PCA decorrelation and rate limiting. IntegrationLayer bridges OpenManus and MCP payloads to memory ops and routes to LLM connectors (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Ollama, mock).

tour.title: Intelligence Layer Overview
tour.description: Three metacognitive modules sit above the storage layer: self_model (capability registry, resource monitor, decision engine), world_model_enhanced (probabilistic state transitions, entity tracking), and coherence (consistency checker, conflict resolver, system invariants). The openspec design doc explains the wiring.

tour.title: World Model: Transitions & Entity Tracking
tour.description: WorldModelEnhanced uses Dirichlet-Multinomial posteriors for state transition prediction and a Kalman filter for entity attribute tracking. The uncertainty module quantifies confidence intervals; the constraint module enforces hard rules on state space.

tour.title: Causal Reasoning & Do-Calculus
tour.description: The causal module implements a directed acyclic graph with do-calculus support for intervention queries. It underpins counterfactual reasoning: given an intervention on a variable, what effect propagates through the causal graph?

tour.title: Self-Model: Decision Engine & Health
tour.description: SelfModel tracks the agent's own capabilities, monitors resource consumption via linear regression, accumulates performance history with EWMA + Bayesian updating, aggregates health as a weighted geometric mean, and selects actions via expected-utility decision theory.

tour.title: Server Surfaces: REST, gRPC & MCP
tour.description: Three server surfaces expose memory ops: the Axum web_server (70+ routes, feature web-server), Tonic gRPC server with protobuf schema, and the combined MCP server that bridges both. The OpenManus bridge adapts agent-protocol payloads.

tour.title: SDKs, CLI & VS Code Extension
tour.description: Client surfaces include the Python SDK (async client + daemon + MCP installer), TypeScript SDK, Continue.dev adapter, CLI binary (memory_cli), and the VS Code extension that auto-captures memories on file save with semantic tag extraction.

tour.title: Testing, Infrastructure & Gap Roadmap
tour.description: Three Rust test binaries cover units, integration (SIT/UAT), and property tests; the Python E2E harness validates the full stack end-to-end. Docker/Helm/CI pipelines handle deployment. The gap-remediation spec (Sprint 1-4) is the active roadmap for production hardening.
